issues.legal_issue: Lineal descendants must be excluded when calculating the number of members of a joint family entitled to compensation if they descend in the main line from another living member entitled to claim partition, even where the family consists only of a father and his sons.
material_facts: A joint Hindu family consisting of a father and his four sons migrated after partition and had left family property behind.
The father's claim for verification of the family property was verified, and the compensation authorities treated the property as joint family property.
A son sought to have the father and sons treated as tenants-in-common, but the authorities applied the rule excluding lineal descendants when calculating the number of family members.
The High Court set aside the authorities' decision; the Supreme Court allowed the appeal against that judgment.
issues.conclusion: The sons were to be excluded from the member count under Rule 19(3)(b), and the High Court was wrong to hold that the rule did not apply where the joint family consisted only of a father and his sons.
issues.legal_principle: Rule 19(2) of the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Rules prescribes compensation calculations according to the number of joint-family members entitled to claim partition. Under Rule 19(3)(b), a person who is a lineal descendant in the main line of another living joint-family member entitled to claim partition is excluded from that count. The Rules were made under section 40 of the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1954. Applying the ordinary meaning of the rule, and the Hindu-law position that a father and each son may claim partition against one another, the Court held that the rule applies even to a family consisting only of a father and his sons. No earlier cases were relied on.

predicates.joint_family_compensation_claim: A claim for compensation was made for property left by a joint family.
predicates.living_ancestor_entitled_to_partition: Another living member of the joint family was entitled to claim partition.
predicates.persons_are_main_line_descendants: The persons whose membership was being calculated were lineal descendants in the main line of that living member.

issues.definition: When a joint-family compensation claim involves persons who are main-line descendants of another living member entitled to claim partition, those descendants are excluded from the member count.
